name: PHYBench
intro: PHYBench 是由 178 名北京大学物理专业学生参与构建的原创符号物理推理基准。流程从 757 道人工编写题出发，经多轮专家审查，并由 81 名学生独立验证后保留 500 题；其中 o1 和 DeepSeek-R1 的输出仅用于帮助审查者发现歧义或误读，不用于生成题目或标准答案。评测同时报告符号等价准确率与表达式编辑距离分数。
org: School of Physics and Institute for Artificial Intelligence, Peking University; Beijing Computational Science Research Center
build_method: 学生人工出题, 多轮专家审查, 独立学生验证
eval_feature: 原创防污染题目, 符号等价检查, 表达式编辑距离, 人类基线
build_method_en: Student-authored Problems, Multi-round Expert Review, Independent Student Validation
eval_feature_en: Original Contamination-resistant Problems, Symbolic Equivalence, Expression Edit Distance, Human Baseline
intro_en: PHYBench is an original symbolic physics reasoning benchmark built with contributions from 178 Peking University physics students. It starts from 757 human-authored problems, applies multi-round expert review, and retains 500 after independent validation by 81 students. Outputs from o1 and DeepSeek-R1 are shown only to help reviewers expose ambiguity or misinterpretation, never to generate questions or ground truth. Evaluation reports both symbolic-equivalence accuracy and Expression Edit Distance.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2504.16074's dataset construction, human validation, prompting, and metric sections plus the official PHYBench page. The diagrams preserve 178 participating Peking University physics students; the 757-to-500 filtering path; original or substantially adapted symbolic-expression problems; broad physics and high-school-to-Olympiad scope; self-contained, unambiguous, uniquely checkable requirements; the internal Question Bank and multi-round review; o1 and DeepSeek-R1 outputs used only to expose ambiguity or misreading, never for question or ground-truth generation; independent validation by 81 students including 50 Chinese Physics Olympiad gold medalists; boxed symbolic zero-shot answers; SymPy/latex2sympy equivalence; Zhang-Shasha tree edit distance; and the paper's exact EED rule: 100 at r=0, 60-100r for 0<r<0.6, and zero for r at least 0.6.
